name: Program Integrity 360 Case
description: State Medicaid program-integrity case lifecycle for Medicaid PCS and State Medicaid Hospice. CaseType selects the evidence path; deterministic rules identify review indicators and Agentic Caseworker recommendations route all material findings to human review. The case never makes a fraud, intent, coverage, or repayment determination.

inputs.name: groundingJson
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({caseType: vars.caseInput?.caseType ?? vars.caseInput?.case_type, caseInput: vars.caseInput, claimInput: vars.claimInput, memberInput: vars.memberInput, providerInput: vars.providerInput, serviceEventInput: vars.serviceEventInput, documentInput: vars.documentInput, currentStage: 'Stage_Corr4a', investigatorDecision: vars.investigatorDecision, investigatorFindings: vars.investigatorFindings, supervisorDecision: vars.supervisorDecision, supervisorReviewNotes: vars.supervisorReviewNotes, allowedNextStages: ['Stage_Evcol2','Stage_Prreq6','Stage_Supv7a','Stage_Clos9a']})

inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({caseType: vars.caseInput?.caseType ?? vars.caseInput?.case_type, hospiceThreshold: 2500, claimTotalBilled: vars.claimInput?.totalBilled ?? vars.claimInput?.total_billed, overlapMinutes: 360, patientClass: 'Observation', reviewIndicatorOnly: true})

data.label: Intake and triage
data.description: Receive six structured claim-intake objects, use CaseType as the routing driver, and apply the deterministic threshold rule before evidence acquisition.
